episodes.synopsis: The first episode begins with a flashback to Misaki's childhood depicting her relationship with her father. Back in 2315, Misaki is just starting her military training in boot camp.
episodes.title: 2315 Allied Force Military Academy

episodes.synopsis: Misaki and her new team begin field training. When a friend from her future visits, the mission becomes much more real.
episodes.title: 2316 Field Practice

episodes.synopsis: Lyar travels back into feudal Japan to find a ghoul. She meets a man who helps her complete her mission.
episodes.title: 1594 The Assassination of Toyotomi Hideyoshi

episodes.synopsis: Still in feudal Japan, Lyar encounters another spectral that appears to be Misaki in her ghoul form.
episodes.title: 1594 Frightful Shadow

episodes.synopsis: A bloody coup attempt is taking place in pre-World War II Japan. The team is alerted to a ghoul presence in the middle of that coup and Kiri and Kotoko are dispatched to attack it. When they arrive, Kiri finds that Misaki is already there and learns about what has been causing all of the strange ghoul events.
episodes.title: 1936 The February 26th Incident

episodes.synopsis: Misaki travels to a time in which her father is still alive and is preparing to go to Watcher's Nest.
episodes.title: 2305 - Allied Military Naval Base

episodes.synopsis: Watcher's Nest comes into contact with a version of itself on another time-line. The team, including Suzanna, travels to it to gather information.
episodes.title: The Two Watcher`s Nests
